original_value: Understanding properties of deep neural networks is an important challenge in deep learning. In this paper, we take a step in this direction by proposing a rigorous way of verifying properties of a popular class of neural networks,  Binarized Neural Networks, using the well-developed means of Boolean satisfiability. Our main contribution is a construction that creates a representation of a binarized neural network as a Boolean formula. Our encoding is the first exact Boolean representation of a deep neural network. Using this encoding, we leverage the power of modern SAT solvers along with a proposed counterexample-guided search procedure to verify various  properties of these networks. A particular focus will be on the critical property of robustness to adversarial perturbations. For this property, our experimental results demonstrate that our approach scales to medium-size deep neural networks used in image classification tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work on verifying properties of deep neural networks using an exact Boolean encoding of the network.

result.paraphrase: Understanding the properties of deep neural networks remains a major challenge in deep learning. In this paper, we address part of that challenge by introducing a rigorous method for verifying properties of a popular neural network class, Binarized Neural Networks, through Boolean satisfiability. Our primary contribution is a construction that represents a binarized neural network as a Boolean formula. This encoding is the first exact Boolean representation of a deep neural network. With it, we combine modern SAT solvers and a counterexample-guided search procedure to verify different properties of these networks. A key emphasis is robustness against adversarial perturbations. For this property, our experiments show that the approach scales to medium-size deep neural networks used in image classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to verify properties of deep neural networks using an exact Boolean encoding of the network.
